entries.27786c8094257149: Sales of Western confectionery including cakes, bakery products and desserts, as well as ice cream. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥25,506 million. Fujiya Western Confectionery Shops operated 850 stores as of the end of the current consolidated fiscal year.
entries.4107512037a0b689: A subsidiary of YAMAZAKI BAKING CO., LTD. that operates Western-style confectionery shops, such as cake shops, and restaurants, and also manufactures and sells confectionery such as "Milky" and "Country Ma'am" as well as beverages.
entries.854ac2eee33e2cf3: This business manufactures and sells confectionery such as chocolate, candy and biscuits, as well as beverages and dairy products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥84,067 million, accounting for 70.3% of consolidated revenue and making it the largest business. In addition to the company, Nihon Shokuzai Co., Ltd., Fujiya Nyugyo Co., Ltd., Fujiya Kobe Co., Ltd., Fujiya (Hangzhou) Food Co., Ltd. in China, Fujiya Vietnam Co.,Ltd. in Vietnam and others undertake this business.
entries.a8fe3fc5d0c30bec: Sales of beverages, dairy products and other items. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,823 million. Key beverage brands include 'Nectar' and 'Lemon Squash'.
entries.c1e44d16872d56df: Operation of tea rooms and restaurants. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥6,332 million. The company works to attract customers through limited-time fair menus and other initiatives.
entries.e1a5cb4f09071292: The business manufactures and sells Western confectionery including cakes, bakery products and desserts, as well as ice cream, and also operates tea rooms and restaurants. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥31,838 million. The company, Daroyal Japon Co., Ltd., [[company:b-r-31-ice-cream|B-R 31 ICE CREAM CO.,LTD.]], and FUJIYA USA Corporation are responsible for it, and the parent company, [[company:yamazaki-baking|YAMAZAKI BAKING CO., LTD.]], is also included among the major companies.
entries.f1098915263c3046: Manufacture and sale of confectionery such as chocolate, candy and biscuits. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥80,244 million. Product brands include 'Milky', 'Country Ma'am', 'Home Pie' and 'Look'.
entries.f7baaa00bbd5da84: This is a business not included in the reportable segments, which engages in mail-order sales and licensing of character merchandise, real estate leasing and management, and clerical contract work and outsourcing services. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,652 million. Fujiya Systems Center Co., Ltd. and others are responsible for it.
